locations.note: Lucky Masters, a former WWI pilot, is hired by E.A. Lomax to rescue his daughter Kate, with the reward shrinking by $20,000 for each day of delay, and he recruits the ninja Zhao Chi.
Lucky and Chi sneak into the fortress of the warlord Li Deng in Chengdu to rescue Kate.
The adventure takes the team through Kathmandu on its route across Asia.
After the rescue the trio pass through Istanbul on the way to Paris.
A later stop on the route through Europe and Asia.
